manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the light blue bowl with darkened rim, stack them one by one.

Task description: Stack the three light blue bowls with dark rims on the table. The large light-colored plate on the left is not part of the task.

Success criteria: The three bowls form a compact vertical stack. Adjacent bowl bodies nearly overlap horizontally, the bottom is close to the table, and the upper two layers sit low and close to the layers below, without obvious excessive height. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a bowl-mouth sidewall section away from obstacles, with one finger inside and one outside. Grasp radially through the local wall and leave only enough opening to surround it, reducing sweeping collisions from excessive opening.
- Before closing, confirm pads cover the inner and outer bowl wall rather than only touching the thin rim top. If the right rim is partly out of view, use the side view to refine the grasp point.
- Keep the bowl opening facing upward during transport. Lift its base off the table and above neighboring rims before moving sideways, and leave room for the gripper to pass the beverage bottle on the right to reduce dragging and tipping.
- When stacking, slowly lower the upper bowl with its bottom facing into the lower bowl’s opening. If one side of the rim touches first, lift slightly and make a small horizontal correction rather than pushing down and shifting the existing stack.
- Leave outer-finger withdrawal clearance from the lower rim during placement. Confirm secure bowl support before releasing and withdrawing to reduce finger trapping between layers or moving the upper bowl.
